current_status.stage: Phase 3 underway in obesity/overweight (AMAZE 1, started Feb 24, 2026, NCT07339423, ~1,150 participants, primary completion June 2029); positive Phase 2 in type 2 diabetes with Phase 3 T2D program planned to start H2 2026
current_status.dosing_target: Weekly (subcutaneous) and once-daily (oral); not yet a true depot/LAI formulation
current_status.data_point: Phase 2 T2D dose-finding study (n=262, doses 0.4-40mg SC vs placebo, 36 weeks): met primary A1C endpoint across all doses and key secondary weight endpoint (doses ≥1.5mg); weight loss up to 14.6% at 40mg vs 2.1% placebo at week 36. Earlier Phase 1b/2a obesity data (Jan 2025): 22% weight loss with weekly SC amycretin at 36 weeks; oral Phase 1: 13.1% weight loss at 12 weeks.

finding_history.summary: Novo Nordisk announced it would advance amycretin (both subcutaneous and oral formulations) into Phase 3 for adults with overweight or obesity, based on end-of-Phase-2 regulatory feedback and early-phase data (published in The Lancet) showing up to 22% weight loss (weekly SC, 36 weeks) and 13.1% weight loss (oral, 12 weeks). Phase 3 program targeted to start Q1 2026.

source.name: Novo Nordisk press release via PR Newswire

finding_history.summary: Novo Nordisk's Phase 3 obesity trial for amycretin (AMAZE 1, NCT07339423) began, targeting ~1,150 participants with week-84 body-weight change as the primary endpoint; primary completion expected June 2029.

Novo Nordisk presented positive Phase 2 dose-finding data for zenagamtide (amycretin), a unimolecular GLP-1/amylin receptor co-agonist, in adults with type 2 diabetes at ADA 2026. The trial met its primary A1C endpoint across all doses and its key secondary body-weight endpoint at doses of 1.5mg and above, with weight reductions up to 14.6% (40mg dose) vs. 2.1% for placebo at week 36, alongside significant A1C reductions. Novo Nordisk plans to start Phase 3 development in T2D in H2 2026.
